nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Hydration Boost Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: many long-time users say the original formula was a holy grail with zero irritation, while one reviewer reports the reformulated version caused painful, inflamed red bumps that had not appeared with the old version.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some in winter or desert climates, report the serum provides noticeable hydration and layers well under a heavier moisturizer.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers with dry, mature skin found the lightweight serum a good match for hyaluronic acid-based routines.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, lightweight hydration that layers well under makeup, but several who compare it to the previous formula say the current version feels sticky, sits on top of the skin, and does not fully absorb or hydrate as well as before.
concerns.redness: The large majority report no irritation, but one reviewer with sensitive skin who had used the original formula for years describes the reformulated serum causing painful, inflamed red bumps around her nose, eyes, lips and cheeks, and a couple of others report mild irritation near the nostrils that faded after the first week.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts from the serum, though one reviewer noted clogged pores and less smooth texture after use.

aspects.libelle: Bottle size reduced while price stayed the same
Reformulated from a long-loved original version
New formula feels sticky and slow to set in

extraits.texte: I have been using the hydrating serum for years, always clean feeling, light, skin always glowed. This new formula is disgusting feeling on my skin, a mucus like texture that never seems to fully sink in, my skin feels dry after putting it on. THE WORST PART: my skin has broken out i have obvious inflammation from this new formula. I do have sensitive skin thats why I used the old formula daily never had an issue which I loved it so much for that reason. This new one tho, there are red bumps big and small around nose eyes lips cheeks i never have pimples in that area......theyre painful and inflammed.. I know it's this because I tried this new formula before and the same darn thing happened. This is crap. My face burns.. why do we need to do these lame revivals of products? I don't want squalene or whatever the heck it is in my simple face moisturizer. Anything to make a sale, whats the IN thing that'll last a year or 2. Then make it a separate product, leave the original. They are nothing alike in allllll the wrong ways... Booooooooooooo!!!!!

I'm in my early 40s with some dryness, hyperpigmentation and sensitive skin. I've been using this a little over a month. I will say if I give it a "half" of pump, enough will come out to cover entire face & part of neck. While I never had any reactions to this, I can't say over a month of using it I've seen much improvement in my skin. I use a few layers of 'higher' end products too & pay attention to the ingredients. I was hoping this would provide the extra hydration & improve appearance on skin, but can't say I've seen much of a difference than what I was using prior. I don't think I'll purchase this again.

extraits.titre: Didn't work well for my skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ultra Repair Hydration Boost Serum feels hydrating at first, but it didn't work well for my skin. After using it, I noticed some clogged pores and my skin texture felt less smooth. It might be better suited for drier or less congestion-prone skin.

I have very dry, occasionally dehydrated, moderately sensitive skin. I also prefer cruelty free products. And, I really don't want to break the bank on skincare products. Its not easy to find the combo I need but FAB checks all the boxes! I love this serum. Its very hydrating, doesn't just sit on the skin, it absorbs well. A little goes a long way too, so one bottle lasts a few months. I've been using this for about 8 mos, fall-spring. Chicago winters are rough on my skin, I walk about 1.5 miles to and from the train 4 days a week. This serum stood up to the test. I highly recommend.

I'm on my third bottle of this now. If you are looking for an intensely lightweight moisturizer for the Summer I highly recommend. I have dry, mature skin and this paid well with FAB Hyaluronic Acid. The moisturizer has an amazing silky texture, goes on light/airy and leaves a slight dewy shine (love). I use it for my day/night routines. If you are drier like I am I wouldn't suggest using during the winter but I think an oily skin type would do well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this hydrating serum—it definitely hydrates well! I noticed deep hydration after only a few uses. The applicator pump gives the perfect amount and I love how skinny and sturdy the bottle is. I did not get any pimples after use which is a huge plus! I did have a little bit of irritation the first week I used it only in the sensitive area below my nostrils, but my skin got used to it quickly.

extraits.titre: Really works for my very sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I love this serum; my face feels so much better when I'm using it. My skin is so sensitive I'm allergic to allergy-tested products, and I know everyone's skin is different but for me this stuff feels amazing and doesn't blow up my face. 10/10
